recipes.title: Warm Beetroot and Lentil Salad
recipes.description: Earthy beetroot, green lentils and a sharp mustard dressing.

steps.text: Cut the beetroot into wedges and warm it with the lentils in a frying pan over medium heat.
Whisk the olive oil, vinegar and mustard. Toss with the warm lentils and beetroot, then fold in the rocket and walnuts.

recipes.notes: Swap walnuts for pumpkin seeds if you prefer.
